updates.name: Alan J. Wallcraft
updates.bio: Senior Research Scientist at Florida State University's Center for Ocean-Atmospheric Prediction Studies (COAPS), on staff there since October 2017 after 37 years supporting the Naval Research Laboratory's global ocean prediction systems for the Navy. Leads development of the HYbrid Coordinate Ocean Model (HYCOM); research spans numerical methods for eddy-resolving ocean circulation models, model coupling and supercomputing.
updates.research_interests: finite-difference and finite-volume numerical methods for PDEs; eddy-resolving ocean circulation modeling; building and maintaining ocean models; running ocean models on scalable supercomputers; model coupling
updates.current_affiliation: Center for Ocean-Atmospheric Prediction Studies (COAPS), Florida State University
updates.notes: COAPS Scientists page lists Alan Wallcraft as Senior Research Scientist and links the profile coaps.fsu.edu/people/alan-wallcraft (200). The profile says the move to COAPS came in Oct 2017 after 37 years with/for NRL, so the NRL-SSC 'faculty' affiliation is likely no longer current and needs a research batch to revise. ORCID 0009-0006-6896-4377 (pub.orcid.org person record fetched: Alan Wallcraft; employment Florida State University, department COAPS) is consistent with the profile. hycom.org/contact-info names Alan Wallcraft as the Model Code contact. Profile's Google Scholar link is a keyword search, not a citations?user= profile, so no google_scholar_id recorded. Verifier rewrote the bio and research_interests to remove copied runs.

updates.name: Peter T. Raimondi
updates.bio: Professor of Ecology & Evolutionary Biology at UC Santa Cruz, also affiliated with the Institute of Marine Sciences. Studies what drives the formation and persistence of marine biological communities, pairing field observations with short-term experiments; recent work examines the causes and effects of variable dispersal using giant kelp as a model, alongside applied ecology.
updates.research_interests: marine community ecology; dispersal variability and its consequences; giant kelp (Macrocystis pyrifera) as a model species; field experiments testing theory; applied ecology
updates.current_affiliation: Ecology & Evolutionary Biology Department, University of California, Santa Cruz
updates.evidence: The Principal Investigator for this group is Pete Raimondi
updates.notes: Old homepage https://www.eeb.ucsc.edu/faculty/raimondi.html returns 404 and is replaced by the UCSC campus directory profile (200 with normal TLS on re-fetch), which gives title Professor, Ecology & Evolutionary Biology, a biography and research interests, and links the shared Raimondi/Carr Lab site rclab.ucsc.edu. eeb.ucsc.edu/people/ lists 'Peter T Raimondi', Professor. marine.ucsc.edu names Pete Raimondi as Principal Investigator of the UCSC rocky intertidal group that built the MARINe website. ORCID 0000-0001-5235-1441 (name Peter Raimondi) has no employments and no fetched official page links it, so not recorded. Verifier replaced the bio with one from the faculty profile.
